Gulshan Kumar and T-Series presents Bhushan Kumar's "Aala Re Aala Ganesha", Sung by Sachet Tandon and the music is by Poonam and the lyrics are penned by Shabbir Ahmed.
Get ready to welcome Bappa On this auspicious occasion of Ganesh Chaturthi, it's time to welcome Lord Ganesh in Bollywood style. Get ready to welcome Bappa with the song Aala Re Aala Ganesha.

Lyricist - Shabbir Ahmed
Music Produced by - Ganesh Waghela & Sanket Gaurav
